Constraint services TEST adaptations
Timefold Solver Community v2.7.0, commit 8b815bc6b5f3eb81feedc94dea0885a93b267762.

constraint_services_cases.rs and constraint_services_fixture.rs adapt the selected
complete Community Spring/Quarkus TEST methods and their TEST domain/provider
helpers, not production implementation. The ordered-pair join, distinct entity
filter, unit penalty, constraint name, two values and score -2/0 are retained.
The native trait recipe replaces Java abstract/concrete provider registration.
Explicit Rust construction replaces classpath scanning, bean injection and native
image behavior. No JVM/CDI/classloader compatibility is claimed.
bavetSolverConfig.xml is copied unchanged from the Community Spring TEST resource.
Original constraint_services_regression.rs tests earn no upstream method credit.
